title: Olympic LOD: Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games as 5-star Linked Open Data
description:
The Tokyo 2020 Olympics Kaggle CSV dump (3 stars at most) turned into 5-star Linked Open Data.

This record contains two snapshots, both inside the archived GitHub release:

  • the 5-star data, in data/rdf/: tokyo2020.ttl (109,679 triples, 0 SHACL violations), validation-report.csv (every SHACL result) and issues-log.csv (source problems kept and flagged);
  • the project: the Linked Data Application Profile (vocabulary alignment, constraints matrix, 9 minted terms) in ldap/, the profile as SHACL shapes with test cases in shacl/, the minted ontology in ontology/, and the reproducible Python pipeline (ingest, clean, reconcile with Wikidata, map to RDF, derive, validate with pySHACL) with its tests.

Vocabularies: FOAF, W3C ORG, the DBpedia ontology, SKOS, DCTERMS, DCAT and OWL, plus the EU human-sex authority table. NOCs, countries, disciplines, medal types and the Games link to Wikidata.
